interest: This document is valuable as an administrative index showing how the U.S. State Department tracked civilian living conditions, housing, and supply issues in Japan during the immediate pre-World War II period. It illustrates the role of major American multinational corporations, specifically the Standard-Vacuum Oil Company, in supplying firsthand economic observations and reports from Japan to U.S. foreign policy divisions in early 1941.
overview: This file contains a Department of State List of Papers (Form DS-46) for decimal file 894.502, relating to housing, dwellings, rents, and living conditions in Japan. The docket sheet records a single entry (sub-number 2) dated March 7, 1941, from the Standard Vacuum Oil Company, which submitted a report concerning supplies and dwellings in Japan to the Department's Far Eastern and economic divisions.

subfiles.about: A State Department List of Papers indexing correspondence under decimal file 894.502 regarding housing and dwelling conditions in Japan.
subfiles.summary: This document is a Department of State List of Papers index sheet (Form DS-46) dated October 11, 1945, cataloguing records under decimal file 894.502 for housing, dwellings, and rents in Japan. It records an incoming communication (sub-number 2) dated March 7, 1941, from the Standard Vacuum Oil Company addressed to Department offices pa/h, ea, and fe. The purport notes that the company submitted a report regarding supplies and dwellings in Japan.
